content.citation_notes: TensorFlow Data Validation documents data statistics, slicing, schema checks, skew, and drift for production ML data.；scikit-learn documents probability calibration for classifier probabilities and the need to improve poorly calibrated probability estimates.；scikit-learn describes calibration curves, also known as reliability diagrams, for visualizing probability calibration.；CalibrationDisplay plots average predicted probability per bin against the fraction of positive classes.；Defines DriftReport, RecalibrationReport and ThresholdStabilityReport, including calibration drift and threshold pressure.
